adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the reference object construction changes `credentialId` from `isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. This definitively drops `credentialId` for non-calendar integrations (e.g., video) where previously the created integration result’s credentialId was persisted. That is a behavior change that can break any later logic that relies on `reference.credentialId` to resolve which credential to use for update/delete of those non-calendar references.
